items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: we went to Charles Levy's office... And, well, they signed me up.

ctx.x: Starlight. Yeah, okay. And I was singing, but that's when Dave Bitholomew, and I guess they heard about me, because Dave Bitholomew, Al Young, who had the record shop, one-stop record shop on Rampart Street, they came to listen to me. And I guess they liked what I heard, what they heard, because that Monday I had an appointment, and I met Dave Bitholomew, and at One Stop Record Shop with me, Al Young, and we went to Charles Levy's office, wherever that was, or somewhere.
